s1.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged man with a history of coronary artery disease and emphysema presents with chest pain, respiratory symptoms, and significant weight loss, found to have a mediastinal mass with mass effect on surrounding structures
salient_findings: Spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli
key_facts: Retrocardiac necrotic mediastinal mass on noncontrast chest CT
Mass effect on esophagus, left atrium, and pulmonary veins
Benign bronchial cells on transbronchial needle aspiration
Spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli on EUS-guided FNA
Positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3
No mutations in cKIT and PDGFRA

raw.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged man with a history of coronary artery disease and emphysema presents with chest pain, respiratory symptoms, and significant weight loss, found to have a mediastinal mass with mass effect on surrounding structures
salient_findings: Spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli
key_facts: Retrocardiac necrotic mediastinal mass on noncontrast chest CT
Mass effect on esophagus, left atrium, and pulmonary veins
Benign bronchial cells on transbronchial needle aspiration
Spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli on EUS-guided FNA
Positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3
No mutations in cKIT and PDGFRA

differentials: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura
per_call: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)
shortlist.why_kept: Positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3, and presence of a spindle cell neoplasm with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli

shortlist.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Positive germline testing for NF1, suggesting a possible association with neurofibromatosis type 1

shortlist.label: Thymoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a retrocardiac necrotic mediastinal mass, which could be consistent with a thymoma

shortlist.label: Thymic carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to thymoma, the presence of a mediastinal mass with mass effect on surrounding structures could suggest thymic carcinoma

shortlist.label: Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Broad category that could encompass various types of sarcomas, including those that could present with a mediastinal mass and systemic symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient's EUS-guided FNA showed a spindle cell neoplasm with positive immunohistochemical staining for CD117, DOG1, Cam5.2, and AE1/AE3, which is consistent with GIST. Additionally, the patient was started on imatinib, a common treatment for GIST.

rejected.label: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
rejected.why: Lack of specific immunohistochemical markers and no mention of nerve sheath origin

rejected.label: Thymoma
rejected.why: No evidence of thymic involvement on imaging and no characteristic immunohistochemical profile

rejected.label: Thymic carcinoma
rejected.why: No evidence of thymic involvement on imaging and no characteristic immunohistochemical profile

rejected.label: Sarcoma
rejected.why: Too broad a category, and the specific immunohistochemical and genetic findings point more specifically to GIST
